source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), Form EIA-930
dataset: Six-month balance CSV, reported (not imputed or adjusted) generation
transformation: Header and selected CSV lines retained byte-for-byte, in original order; all original columns retained. No values generated or interpolated.
timestamp_convention: Native UTC Time at End of Hour. Normalize to aware UTC interval end; interval_start_utc is one hour earlier.
unit_note: Native six-month headers label hourly average power as MW. These are hourly integrated/time-weighted values per EIA documentation; energy for one hour is value multiplied by 1 hour, numerically equal MWh. API fuel-type-data natively reports megawatthours.
